model.eligibility_note: Open weights. Licence is the Llama 3.3 Community License Agreement (HF licence tag llama3.3), read 2026-11-17 by the orchestrator on the quant repo and the Meta Llama 3.3 model card. A custom community licence with acceptable-use and scale conditions, NOT OSI-approved: this slot is open-weight, not open-source. Quantisation Q8_0. Served self-hosted via llama.cpp on VT ARC Falcon over an SSH tunnel on localhost:8082; serving history, same model and quant: fal034:42003 (2026-11-17, twelve slot-09 research runs and one build), fal052:49161 (2026-11-17, current). max_tokens is 16000 for this slot, not the 32000 used by slots 07, 08 and 10: this server reports n_ctx 48128 per slot, so a 32000-token output cap left only about 16000 tokens for the prompt, and every slot-09 build failed at the correction stage, where the conversation carries the build history plus the QC failure list. Recorded as a deliberate per-slot difference in generation parameters.

tool_access: chat-completions API only: no browsing, no shell, no filesystem. The orchestrator wrote every file and ran every check.
